name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt of India
short_description: Financial assistance of Rs. 1.20 Lakh to Rs. 1.30 Lakh to rural homeless and families living in kutcha houses for pucca house construction.
detailed_description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all rural families who are homeless or living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, with unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 Lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 Lakh in hilly/difficult areas, alongside 90-95 days of unskilled wage labor under MGNREGS.
description_kannada: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಭಾಗದ ಬಡ, ನಿರಾಶ್ರಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಮನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಕ್ಕಾ ಮನೆ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ರೂ. 1,20,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುವ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Rural Residence
rules.clarification_question_en: Do you live in a rural village area?

rules.name: Annual Family Income <= Rs. 1.5 Lakh
rules.source_citation: SECC 2011 Rural Deprivation Criteria for Housing
rules.description_kannada: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಆದಾಯ ರೂ. 1.5 ಲಕ್ಷ ಮೀರಬಾರದು
rules.clarification_question_en: What is your approximate annual family income?

benefits_summary: Financial grant of Rs. 1,20,000 for house construction + MGNREGA wages (~Rs. 25,000) + Rs. 12,000 for toilet under SBM.
required_documents: Document of land/site ownership or Gram Panchayat allotment
application_process: Beneficiary list is drawn from SECC/Awaas+ data and verified by Gram Sabha.
Registration is done by Panchayat Secretary via the AwaasSoft portal with geotagged photo of existing kutcha house.
source_title: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
source_excerpt: To achieve the objective of providing 'Housing for All' in rural areas, unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh is provided in plain areas.
